description: Critical Specialization represents the ability to exploit weaknesses and inflict particularly dangerous attacks. These Talents do not require an Attack to possess Critical beforehand. Critical Specialization effects may activate alongside Critical Prowess or inherent Critical.
notes: Deadly Opening is removed from this specialization to avoid overlapping with existing accuracy and Attack improvements.

talents.name: Exploit Weakness
talents.effect: When your Attack Surges, add one additional damage per rank of Exploit Weakness to the damage pool.

talents.name: Perfect Strike
talents.effect: When your Attack Surges, deal Direct Damage 1 to its target for each Surge generated by that Attack; Ward applies.

talents.name: Critical Force
talents.effect: Choose one Weapon Attack. Once per Attack, if at least one Critical Hit from it survives applicable Ward Saves, increase the Damage of ONE such Critical Hit by 1. This adds +1 total Damage to the Critical pool, NOT +1 per Critical Hit. Works with passive or CP-granted Critical.

talents.name: Greater Critical Force
talents.effect: Increase the once-per-Attack Critical Force bonus from +1 total Damage to +2 total Damage. Never multiply the bonus by the number of Critical Hits.
